messageLetter: To you two:
I'll only be away for a few days.
Don't turn the infirmary upside down while I'm gone.
Your duties are simple:
Change the bedsheets, organize the cabinets, and water the flowers.
I've already taught you how to do all that.
Remember, water the flowers, not the bedsheets.
Do not open the medicine cabinet.
Do not touch my medical equipment.
Especially the defibrillator.
Let me make this perfectly clear.
It is NOT for waking people up.
Nor is it a toy for testing who's more energetic.
If anything strange drifts in from outside again,
leave it alone until I get back.
If it's a human, just let them rest quietly.
No response does NOT mean you should increase the voltage.
And it certainly doesn't mean you should try again.
Also, about that nurse uniform on the chair.
I know you bought it to replace the one you ruined.
I appreciate the thought, really.
But… didn't you buy a size that's too big?
It fits perfectly around the waist, but that one part…
…N-Never mind! It must be the design!
…I-It's not like it bothers me that much!
It's just that this outfit is designed so strangely!
A-Anyway!
I absolutely refuse to work in an outfit like that!
Get rid of it before I come back!
And don't you dare stuff padding into the chest without my permission!
Anyway, behave yourselves while I'm gone.
If you're good, I'll bring back some treats.
— Your loving Head Nurse
P.S.
The skeleton model in the hallway was store-bought.
Stop scaring people by telling them it was the last patient who misbehaved.
